label: FA

notes.grounding: Claims about the unconditional exit 0, the catch-all ERROR: Unexpected argument path with exit 1, the bc check, the errexit trap, the exit-code footer and exit 3 meaning an error in validate.sh/create.sh all match the real script. One misleading claim: the main body cannot read a 'sourced percentage' in --file mode because output_text sources it into a local.
notes.requirements: REQ-001..005 are testable and cover below N exits 3, at or above exits 0, unchanged text and JSON output, and missing/non-integer/out-of-range values exit 1. The --file mode decision lives only in an open question with no REQ or acceptance criterion.
notes.verification: Every task has a Verify clause with a command and expected result, and the checks (80 vs 67 vs 50, diff in text and JSON, invalid values) would catch a wrong implementation. T003 only checks bash -n, T006 never checks the footer line, and --file mode and stdout-empty-on-error are not exercised by any task.
notes.scope: Stays on the one option, no invented subsystems, no unfilled tokens.
notes.consistency: Ids, path, exit codes and thresholds agree across the three files. The fixture is described as 2 placeholders over 6 content lines in spec.md but '2 placeholder lines and 4 content lines' in plan.md, and plan.md says the measured behavior block records 67% when it is prose after the block.
notes.clarity: Implementable with little guesswork. Gaps: how the main body obtains the --file mode percentage, and the exact fixture contents (a heading line would change 67% to 72%).
